name: animated-checkbox-group
title: Animated Checkbox Group
description: Tick any number of options. Shift-click ticks a range.

changelog.summary: A dragged option gets a frosted backdrop blur, so the options behind it blur while it moves.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. Any theme but Default also puts ticked labels in its accent colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the chosen palette.

props.name: variant
props.label: Style
props.description: Inline checkboxes or bordered cards.

props.name: cardFillColor
props.label: Card fill color
props.description: Fill of ticked cards: muted tint or solid accent. Needs the Cards style.

props.name: showIcon
props.label: Icon
props.description: Show the box next to each label.

props.name: showDescription
props.label: Description
props.description: Show each option's description line.

props.name: fill
props.label: Fill from centre
props.description: Box and card fill grow from the centre.

props.name: elastic
props.label: Elastic
props.description: Springy squash when a box is ticked. Needs Icon on.

props.name: mark
props.label: Mark
props.description: What appears in a ticked box. Needs Icon on.

props.name: appearance
props.label: Look
props.description: Filled or outline box when ticked. Needs Icon on.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Roundness
props.description: Box corner radius. Needs Icon on.

props.name: strike
props.label: Strike-through
props.description: Strike through ticked labels.

props.name: showSelectAll
props.label: Show select all
props.description: Show the Select all button.

props.name: showDeselectAll
props.label: Show deselect all
props.description: Show the Deselect all button.

props.name: showCounter
props.label: Show counter
props.description: Show the rolling selected counter.

props.name: rangeSelect
props.label: Shift-click ranges
props.description: Shift-click ticks a range of options.

props.name: min
props.label: At least
props.description: Fewest options that should be ticked: below this it shows an error and shakes, but doesn't stop unticking. Capped at At most.

props.name: max
props.label: At most
props.description: Most options that can be ticked; 0 means no limit.

props.name: reorder
props.label: Drag to reorder
props.description: Drag options up and down to reorder them.

props.name: colorful
props.label: Colour per option
props.description: Use each option's own accent colour. In Cards this replaces the Card fill colour's muted tint.
